title: Record a salary payment from the suggested remaining amount
description: This verifies that the payment form suggests the remaining payable amount and records a payment that updates paid, remaining, and status.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Open the payment form for an employee
Verify a suggested remaining payable amount is displayed
Enter the suggested remaining amount as the payment value
Submit the payment
Verify the paid amount, remaining amount, and status are updated

title: Sign in and reach the staff cockpit home
description: This verifies that a staff user can authenticate and land on the internal cockpit home screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops
Fill in email with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in password with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign in form
Verify the staff cockpit home is displayed

title: Create an employee and see them in the payroll list
description: This verifies that a staff user can add an employee and immediately find them in the current month payroll view.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Open the employee form
Fill in the employee name with a unique test name
Fill in the designation field with a test role
Fill in the monthly salary field with a valid amount
Fill in the start date field with a valid date
Select a default weekly off day
Save the employee
Verify the new employee appears in the current month payroll list

title: See payable update when attendance changes
description: This verifies that marking absences changes the employee payable while weekly off days remain included.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Expand an employee row
Note the current payable amount
Mark one or more working days as absent
Verify the payable amount decreases
Verify weekly off days remain included in the payroll calculation

title: Edit an employee and keep them visible in payroll
description: This verifies that a saved employee can be edited and remains present in the month payroll list with updated details.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Open the employee form for an existing employee
Update the employee name with a unique edited name
Update the monthly salary field with a different valid amount
Save the employee
Verify the edited employee remains visible in the current month payroll list

title: Switch between cockpit sections
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can navigate between cockpit sections and each requested screen loads.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=home
Select the staff section
Verify the staff screen is displayed
Select the expenses section
Verify the expenses screen is displayed
Select the money section
Verify the money screen is displayed
Select the settings section
Verify the settings screen is displayed

title: Move between payroll months
description: This verifies that switching months updates the payroll list to the selected month.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Switch to the previous month
Verify the payroll list updates for the previous month
Switch to the next month
Verify the payroll list updates for the next month

title: Mark attendance across a single employee row
description: This verifies that an employee row can be expanded and a day mark can be cycled through attendance states for that month.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Expand an employee row
Tap a calendar day mark once
Tap the same calendar day mark again
Tap the same calendar day mark a third time
Verify the day mark cycles through work, absent, and off states

title: Open the executive home screen from cockpit navigation
description: This verifies that the executive home view can be opened from the cockpit and loads its KPI-style content.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Select the home section
Verify the home dashboard is displayed
Verify KPI-style content is displayed

title: Review salary history by month
description: This verifies that monthly salary and payment history can be inspected from the staff payroll view.

steps.description: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff
Open an employee's monthly history view
Switch to a different month in the history view
Verify salary or payment history for the selected month is displayed
